description: This file defines a set of debugging actions within a macOS application, including window management, file operations, app restarting, session handling, and network diagnostics using SwiftUI and AppKit.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a window displaying agent events, using SwiftUI's AgentEventsWindow view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in Finder; shows an alert if the log file is missing.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the application's configuration directory in Finder.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store directory or file depending on its existence.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification via NotificationManager.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command using VoiceWakeForwarder and returns the result.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway or resets the remote tunnel depending on the connection mode, managing related components.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel when in remote mode, ensuring a fresh control tunnel.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate health check by refreshing the health store.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat and returns the result.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Checks if verbose logging is enabled in UserDefaults.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging setting and notifies the control channel.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application by relaunching the executable.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding flags and restarts the onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Determines the session store path from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent sessions up to a specified limit asynchronously.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session settings with thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Performs diagnostics on gateway ports.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID, with fallback to force kill.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store in VS Code if available.
